CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTPARTICIPATIONAUTHORIZEDSIGNATORY_LNS
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory AS 
(
SELECT
	BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM AS SerialNumber
	,BLA.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
	,BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE AS RecordTypeId
	,BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_NAME AS CustomerName
	,BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS AS CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatoryNote
	,BLA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BLA.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BLAD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN_DELTA BLAD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN BLA ON BLAD.ACID = BLA.ACID AND BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM = BLAD.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM  AND  BLAD.BANK_ID = BLA.BANK_ID AND BLA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM = '001' -- ADDED FOR DUPE
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG ON BLA.ACID = BLG.ACID AND BLA.ISLATEST = 1
WHERE BLG.FORACID IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,SerialNumber
,Timestamp
,RecordTypeId
,CustomerName
,CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatoryNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,SerialNumber
,Timestamp
,RecordTypeId
,CustomerName
,CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatoryNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'LNS'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
	,SerialNumber = SRC.SerialNumber
	,Timestamp = SRC.Timestamp
	,RecordTypeId = SRC.RecordTypeId
	,CustomerName = SRC.CustomerName
	,CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatoryNote = SRC.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatoryNote
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
	,TaskRunId = 0
	,WorkFlowId = 0
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId ;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory
(
	CustomerAccountId
	,SerialNumber
	,Timestamp
	,RecordTypeId
	,CustomerName
	,CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatoryNote
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT
	CustomerAccountId
	,SerialNumber
	,Timestamp
	,RecordTypeId
	,CustomerName
	,CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatoryNote
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_DELTA;

END
